proposed_edges.relationship: In ‘Refiguring Imperial Terrains’ (2006), their introduction to the edited volume Imperial Formations, which includes Burbank’s chapter ‘The Rights of Difference’, Ann Laura Stoler and Carole McGranahan adopt her account of the Russian empire’s differential distribution of rights, writing that imperial formations are founded on ‘sliding scales of basic rights’.
proposed_edges.evidence_note: The journal’s English text credits Burbank’s Russian case in the authors’ account of unequal rights and later develops her analysis of group privileges and local legal practice.
